overall_assessment: The main index.html is already well-designed with minimal 'vibe-coded slop'. However, applying the unslop methodology will refine it further and ensure consistency.

emoji_labels.assessment: Minor - tech section emoji could be replaced with lucide line icons for consistency
emoji_labels.fix: Replace emoji with lucide icons (e.g., 🐍 → Lucide Snake, 🐼 → Lucide Panda, etc.)

uppercase_tracking.assessment: Good - no uppercase tracked labels in main project

hue_gradients.assessment: Good - using midnight/teal/champagne palette, not hue-spanning gradients

direction_derivation.product: AEROVISION 360 - Enterprise-grade business intelligence platform that transforms multi-airline operational and financial data into executive insight via five Power BI report pages, 120 visuals, and 54 governed DAX measures.
direction_derivation.world: aviation analytics - instruments, night flight paths, radar data, navigation charts, cockpit instrumentation
direction_derivation.moments: Rendered chart visualization, KPI number displays, operational flight data visualization, semantic model table preview
direction_derivation.signature: The midnight teal accent color (#63B3A5) paired with Playfair Display headings for elegant data presentation

nine_passes_assessment.1_spacing: Good foundation - uses CSS custom properties (--spacing-xs through --spacing-xl). All values are consistent. Minor: some Tailwind spacing classes could be verified against 4px grid.
nine_passes_assessment.2_color: Strong palette - midnight (#101820) base, teal accent (#63B3A5), champagne accent (#D6A45D). No hue gradients on surfaces. Accent used sparingly for primary actions. Text contrast adequate.
nine_passes_assessment.3_icons: Uses emoji in tech stack section (📊, 🐍, etc.). Should replace with consistent line icon set (lucide). One size, one stroke rule applies.
nine_passes_assessment.4_copy: Clean copy without hype words, no !!, no gradient-text. Some section labels could be more concise. Badges like 'PRO' use emoji context.
nine_passes_assessment.5_type: Uses Playfair Display (serif) for headings and Inter for body - a good contrasting pair. Hierarchy via size not weight. Sentence case used. No italic for emphasis.
nine_passes_assessment.6_layout: Well-structured hero, sections, and dashboard layout. Keeps real proportions. Hero composition follows the scene pattern with visual rising from bottom.
nine_passes_assessment.7_details: Nested radius system (--radius: 6px, --radius-sm: 4px) properly implemented. Charts sit on muted grid. Nested radii add up correctly.
nine_passes_assessment.8_visuals: Uses actual data visualization (Chart.js) rather than AI filler. Product preview shown in dashboard. Hero has metrics section, not just generic blob.
nine_passes_assessment.9_motion: No looping animations, no animate-pulse/ping. Transitions are deliberate and named (transition-colors). Hover/focus states exist for keyboard access.

recommendations.primary: Replace emoji tech icons with lucide line icons for visual consistency
recommendations.secondary: Minor typography refinements and ensuring all spacing follows the established 4px grid rigorously
recommendations.tertiary: Create story video documenting the screen's existing quality (it's already well-designed)
